news.snippet: Sakana AI表示优先打造具有代际意义的AI公司，2027年IPO计划显示其长期商业化信心。
news.raw_snippet:
“Our priority remains building a generational AI company that serves as Japan’s national AI champion,” the post read.

Reports of a Sakana AI IPO come as artificial intelligence companies globally face a broad range of challenges related to valuations, resistance to data centers and questions about the usefulness of the technology. [...] AI shares were particularly hard-hit after U.S. midterm elections on concerns that a Democratic Party-dominated House and Senate would lead to stricter AI regulations and slow data center construction.

The Nasdaq is down about 9% from its all-time high in part on AI’s retreat.

Sakana AI raised ¥32 billion ($200 million) in Series B funding from global sponsors including Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Google and Citi. Nvidia was a participant in an earlier Series A funding round. [...] 2 min

, media reports say.

According to Nikkei, which broke the news, the company’s market capitalization could exceed Mercari’s ¥680 billion ($4.3 billion) and set Sakana AI on track to become one of Japan’s most valuable startup listings. Goldman Sachs has been hired as an adviser, according to the report.

In an X post on Monday, Sakana AI said it has no near-term plans for an IPO.

news.title: 初创公司创始人用AI申请专利：DIY何时变成风险
news.snippet: 创始人可用AI整理技术文档准备专利申请，但DIY在权利要求环节可能带来法律风险。
news.raw_snippet:
Founders can use AI to organize technical documentation, summarize existing patents and identify potentially relevant prior art. Turning engineering notes into an organized invention disclosure, for example, can reduce preparation costs and help counsel focus on strategy. [...] Nathan Mutter, managing partner and founder of Landfall IP.

Nathan Mutter, managing partner and founder of Landfall IP.

The question isn’t whether startups should use AI. It’s how much founders can safely do themselves and when legal expertise becomes essential.

## Where AI can help startups save time and money [...] Unclear ownership. Paying an employee or contractor does not substitute for securing appropriate invention assignments. Secure those agreements when people join, rather than waiting for diligence to expose gaps. Founders should also assign relevant work to the company and verify obligations to prior employers or universities. Ownership gaps can derail fundraising or acquisitions.

news.title: 我们的AI初创公司融资4000万美元后，一名工程师质问为何无人使用产品
news.snippet: AI Agent可审核发票、对账与记录更新，但产品缺乏真实用户，促使创业团队反思PMF与产品价值。
news.raw_snippet:
An AI agent could review invoices, reconcile records, update CRM data, generate reports, and coordinate actions across multiple business systems. Our demonstrations made these workflows look almost effortless.

Investors loved the market opportunity.

Enterprise software was expensive, operational teams were overwhelmed, and executives were desperate to understand whether generative AI could reduce labor costs.

Our CEO, Nathan, understood that demand better than anyone. [...] I asked whether the tracking was broken.

Maya said she’d checked the raw event logs, database records, and workflow execution history. The numbers were real.

Across the room, our CEO raised a glass.

“To the future of enterprise automation.”

Maya closed her laptop.

“Apparently the future hasn’t logged in.”
